caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical container, resembling a lidded mug or tankard, placed centrally on a plain, lightly textured background. The container has a smooth body and is fitted with a domed lid that features evenly spaced small holes across its surface, suggesting it might function as a shaker or strainer. At the top of the lid, there is an ornamental finial. The container has a decorative handle on the right side with a curved design and a small curled accent at both ends. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray, using fine lines and subtle shading to convey the metallic texture and three-dimensional form of the object. The background is an off-white or light beige color, and there is a small, neat signature and date in the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Caster
